'''Tito''' (Japanese: '''リト''' ''Rito'') is a minor recurring character in ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''.

Tito first appeared in ''[[JN031|The Cuteness Quotient!]]'', in which he competed in the [[Friendship Festival]] with his {{p|Corsola}} but did not manage to win a prize.

Tito reappeared in ''[[JN063|On Land, In the Sea, and to the Future!]]'', where he was among the competitors taking part in the [[Marine Athletic Race|Kids Marine Athletic Race]]. He ended up finishing third.
